risk: Unmatched routing conditions trigger Escalation End Event (EndEvent_11) resulting in unhandled message drop in OneWay MEP.
consequence: Inbound Sales Orders and Return notifications that do not meet explicit router predicates are terminated abruptly without notifying the sender or delivering to Glovia REST receivers.
mitigation: Automated scenario TC_GLOVIA_003 asserts that the default route branches to SequenceFlow_110 and produces escalation code 'RoutingConditionNotMet', allowing monitoring alert rules to be verified.

risk: Disconnection of floating elements CallActivity_77 and CallActivity_86 in BPMN model definition.
consequence: The validation script GLOVIA_Conditioncheck_Salesorder_Create.groovy and XPath header extraction for OrganizationId are never executed during runtime, potentially leading to incorrect routing or missing downstream parameters.
mitigation: Test suite asserts on exact route branch outcomes and identifies disconnected canvas artifacts in coverage analysis so developers can connect or retire dead steps.

risk: MessageMapping_102 failure due to missing mandatory XML elements in Salesforce outbound notification body.
consequence: Uncaught XML transformation exceptions halt order creation for participant Glovia_Get_CreateOrder_Details_REST_Receiver, producing message processing failures.
mitigation: TC_GLOVIA_004 verifies that SubProcess_91 captures the failure, reads back ${property.InputPayload} safely via CallActivity_97, attaches it for support analysis via CallActivity_100, and ends cleanly at EndEvent_95.

risk: Parallel Multicast gateway ParallelGateway_74 configured with a single outgoing sequence flow.
consequence: Unnecessary thread overhead and architectural drift if additional branches are added without synchronizing join gateways.
mitigation: TC_GLOVIA_001 and TC_GLOVIA_002 validate that single-branch execution through SequenceFlow_109 does not cause deadlocks or race conditions.
